path.description: Written file (null when the points were returned inline).

excluded.description: Points dropped for `avoid` (within its radius of an earlier layer).

points.description: The points (`u` east, `v` north from the south edge, `z`, `r`) when no `path` was given.

ScatterPoint.description: A scattered instance in world metres (`u` east, `v` north from the south edge, `z` height).

u.description: Easting from the west edge, metres.

v.description: Northing from the south edge, metres.

z.description: Terrain height at the point (0 when no height layer is given).

r.description: Deterministic 0..1 value per point for the caller's own variation (scale, rotation).
